name: PERFORM
facts: Fuel your day to help your mind & body adapt to modern-day chaos.
Oat drink with 750mg Lion’s Mane extract.
Contains Vitamin B6 & B12, which contribute to normal energy-yielding metabolism.

Reference intake of an average adult (8400kJ / 2000kcal)
